findings.issue: R6 says mappings-demo.yaml maps every field to demo-esg- spreadsheet IDs, but the test only checks spreadsheet and sheet for the three energy_total names (the 'demo layout' block). For every other field it checks only that the name exists and that its range is D<row>. If a src_ field were mapped to demo-esg-report-cy (empty values) or to a non-demo spreadsheet, every test would still pass. The demo read would then return empty and only scenario 3's single field would notice.
findings.fix: In the per-field loop, for mappings-demo.yaml, assert that the ref for Source is on demo-esg-source/demo-esg-source-2025, Target on demo-esg-report/demo-esg-report-cy and Prior on demo-esg-report/demo-esg-report-py (which implies the demo-esg- prefix). Then drop or keep the three-name block.

findings.issue: R3 says every share is between 0 and 100%, but the percent-range check loops only over the 2025 rows. Shares in esg-2024.csv are never checked, even though the totals check covers both years.
findings.fix: Run the 0..100 check over both cur and prior.

findings.issue: Three //nolint:gosec comments were added (lines 35, 120, 156). No other Go file in internal/ or cmd/ uses nolint. The owner's standing rule forbids adding ignore comments to get checks green. This is outside the spec axis, so it is noted here for the standards reviewer.
findings.fix: Remove the nolint comments and satisfy gosec another way (for example filepath.Clean on the path, or a repo-level gosec exclusion if the owner approves one). Otherwise record it as an open question.
